correctness.rationale: All-parameter proof derives exact clique/independent update including equality, classifies all fixed and primitive period-two states, counts disjoint orbit classes, and shows entry by time three with explicit family of exact three-step witnesses. Computation is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Complete split graphs are a natural two-block threshold-graph family interpolating between stars and complete graphs. A full count and classification of the only recurrent cycles exposes three qualitatively distinct disagreement mechanisms and sharp parity/size thresholds. The explicit, attained constant settling bound gives an exact benchmark for module-based majority theory. This two-parameter structural classification is not a textbook restatement, arbitrary slice, or unsupported extrapolation.
